surelyremote.text:
BJAK

Applied AI Engineer

This role focuses on building practical AI agents, workflows, and automations to improve financial products and operational efficiency. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to deploy reliable AI solutions that handle real-world constraints like latency, security, and compliance. The position requires hands-on engineering experience with LLMs, RAG systems, and production-grade software development.

Responsibilities
Build AI agents, workflows, tools, and automations to solve customer and operational problems.
Ship production features with appropriate evaluation and monitoring.

Requirements
Full-time. Remote.
Experience with LLMs and RAG systems.

Written by Surely Remote
